name: working-day
description: Working-day: monorepo combinado (back + front) con arranque unico y .env raiz

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n back,front -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w horary-back" "npm run dev -w horary-front"
scripts.start: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n back,front -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w horary-back" "npm run start -w horary-front"
